[b][size=5][center]FARM SAFETY NET – DOUBLE-CLICK BOMB SAFETY[/center][/size][/b]
[center]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements
[/url]﻿[/size][/center]


Ever accidentally dropped a bomb on your farm and instantly regretted it?
Farm Safety Net adds a simple confirmation step so bombs don’t detonate from a single misclick.

When you are holding a bomb in a safe area, the first click is blocked and a warning appears.
Click again within one second to confirm and place the bomb normally.



[b]WHAT THIS MOD DOES[/b]

[list]
[*]Prevents accidental bomb placement with a double-click confirmation
[/list][list]
[*]Shows a clear on-screen warning before detonation
[/list][list]
[*]Works with both left-click (Use Tool) and right-click (Action)
[/list][list]
[*]Does not interfere with menus or toolbar UI
[/list]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40824/40824-1767490730-526702839.png[/img]﻿[/center]


[b]IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR – PLEASE READ[/b]

[b]When you are holding a bomb, switching to other tools or items on the toolbar may require a double hit.[/b]

This is intentional.

The mod blocks the first click as a safety check while a bomb is selected.
Any action performed during that moment will need a second click to go through.

[b]In short:[/b]

[list]
[*]Holding a bomb = first click is ignored
[*]Second click performs the action
[/list]

This prevents accidental detonations caused by fast item swapping or misclicks.



[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]SAFE ZONES (WHERE CONFIRMATION APPLIES)[/b]
[/size][/color]
The double-click confirmation only triggers in the following locations:

[list]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=3]Farm[/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=3]Farmhouse[/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=3]Cellar[/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=3]Greenhouse[/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=3]Ginger Island (Island West)[/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=3]Sheds[/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=3]Barns and Coops[/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=3]Slime Hutch[/size][/color]
[/list]

[color=#ff0000][size=5]Outside these areas, bomb placement behaves normally.
[/size][/color]


[b]COMPATIBILITY & SAFETY[/b]

[list]
[*]No assets added or replaced
[*]No save data changes
[*]Safe to install or remove at any time
[*]Compatible with other gameplay and utility mods
[/list]



[b]FAQ[/b]

[b]Will this stop me from using bombs in the Mines?[/b]
No. Mines are not treated as safe zones, so bombs work normally there.

[b]Why do I sometimes need to click twice holding a bomb then switch to tool?[/b]
If you were holding a bomb, the mod blocks the first click as a safety check. The second click is the real action.
